children: Investors could place greater value on Indonesia's fiscal credibility and policy predictability instead of further aggressive government stimulus after the latest finance minister appointment, Maybank Sekuritas's Jeffrosenberg Chenlim says in a report. The appointment of Suahasil Nazara is likely to be viewed positively by financial markets as he is an established technocrat. Suahasil's familiarity with the government budget process and broader fiscal framework should ensure policy continuity. He is also generally associated with fiscal discipline. This is particularly relevant as investors have become more sensitive to Indonesia's fiscal outlook and its broader economic policy direction, Chenlim says.(amanda.lee@wsj.com)
